test_title: PYST 15: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

‘A + B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’

‘A – B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the father of B’

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’

Based on the above, how is P related to Z if ‘W + Y − Z ÷ X + P’?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Husband 
 Sister
 Father 
 Mother
 
 

 

Given: W + Y − Z ÷ X + P

It means: W is the husband of Y, Y is the sister of Z, Z is the mother of X and X is the husband of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ecc5c45de6570ef6877c9de8deaaa34fca4d9e2020449fb1bea6fca635653de4.png] 

So, P is the **'Son's wife**' of Z.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
